## Initial Checklist

**This PR must meet the requirements of this checklist first. It will not be accepted until it does.**

- [ ] I have disclosed use of any AI generated code or content in my commit messages (if I used AI).
  - General rule of thumb: if you do not know about what the AI wrote, that's a bad thing and your PR will be scrutinized.
  - Based on experience, AI usually gives overly complex code and documentation. It is more tolerable if the AI helped you find the algorithm and you wrote the code or the AI did a menial task like refactoring.
  - Archipelago requires disclosure of AI generated content. Moving forward, code written by AI MUST be disclosed.
- [ ] I understand these changes in full and will be able to respond to review comments.
- [ ] My change is accurately described in the commit message.
- [ ] My contribution is tested and working as described.
- [ ] I certify that it is my code and content and that I am allowed to submit it for this open source project.

Trying to skirt the guidelines will lead to you being banned from making PR's with any of my projects.
